type: SaaS creative tool — transferable light-SaaS motion pattern

fonts.labels: mono 11px lowercase 'There's a block for that'

moves: floating pill nav split in two pills: logo+menu left, Login+CTA right (bottom-anchored on mobile)
hero: 3D keychain charms hanging from top (mobile) / word-by-word BLUR-IN reveal of headline
logo marquee under 'Teams from top brands…'
manifesto sentence as huge text with inline image-icons between words (emoji-like product thumbnails)
giant dark rounded product panel (video timeline) full-width with soft shadow glow
2-col: text left with blur-in on scroll (words sharpen as they enter), product grid right bleeding off the edge
mobile: single column, product panel full-width, headline blur-in retained
rules_derived: blur-in text reveal (filter: blur(12px)→0 + opacity) per word = premium feel, cheap
product UI shown big and bleeding off-canvas = confidence
regular-weight large type on near-white = calm SaaS
